title: Understanding E-Commerce and the treatment of FinTechs in the National Payment System (Edition 4, 2022)
summary: Public awareness edition from the Bank of Namibia's National Payment System Department explaining e-commerce, what FinTechs are, and how the Bank's FinTech Innovations Regulatory Framework treats innovations not covered by existing regulation. Quantum-safe cryptography is listed only as one example of FinTech technologies.
